views.failed: The view could not be saved.

security.title: Security
security.copy: Second factor, recovery codes and the sessions open on your account.
security.factorsCopy: After the password, Horizon asks for one of these.
security.noFactors: No second factor yet. Add an authenticator app or a passkey.
security.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}
security.sessionsCopy: Where your account is signed in to this workspace. Ending a session also invalidates its tokens.
security.othersEnded: {count, plural, =0 {No other session was open.} one {# session ended.} other {# sessions ended.}}

stepUp.title: Confirm your identity
stepUp.copy: This action is sensitive. Enter your password and, if you have one, your second factor's code.
stepUp.codeNeeded: Your account has a second factor: enter the code too.
stepUp.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

totp.stepScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
totp.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.wrongCode: Wrong code. Check your phone's clock and try the next one.

recovery.title: Keep your recovery codes
recovery.copy: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

enroll.title: Add an authenticator app
enroll.copy: This workspace requires a second factor and the time to add one has ended. Add it now and sign in again.

invitation.unusableCopy: The link expired, was already used or was revoked. Ask whoever administers the workspace for a new one.
invitation.acceptedCopy: You now belong to {workspace}. Sign in with your email and password.
invitation.title: Join {workspace}
invitation.existingCopy: {email} already has a Horizon account. Confirm with that account's password.
invitation.newCopy: Choose the password you will use with {email}.
invitation.name: Your name
invitation.wrongPassword: That is not your account's password.
invitation.failed: The invitation could not be accepted.

audit.title: Audit
audit.copy: Who did what, and when, across every module you administer. Each module checks its own hash chain; a tampered row shows as broken.
audit.failed: The audit logs could not be loaded.
audit.noneReadable: You administer no module with an audit log.
audit.filtersCopy: Narrow by module, person, action, record and period.
audit.exportHint: Every matching row, up to 50,000, with each module's chain verdict.
audit.chainCopy: Each module recomputes every row it returned and checks its links to the rows around it.

reports.title: Reports
reports.copy: Figures from several modules at one cutoff. A report is settled once every source has proven it is complete through the cutoff; until then it may still change.
reports.askCopy: Choose the report, the moment it answers for, and a currency if you want only one.
reports.settledCopy: Every source is complete through the cutoff: these figures will not change.
reports.unsettledCopy: Some sources are still arriving: these figures may change until they settle.
reports.noFigures: Nothing to show at this cutoff.
reports.reconcileCopy: Compares these figures with each owning module's own report at the same cutoff.
reports.exportCopy: The report at this cutoff as a file, now or on a schedule. Each file carries its SHA-256 digest; its link lasts 15 minutes.
reports.exportRequested: Export requested; it appears below when ready.
reports.exportFailed: The file could not be requested.
reports.linkFailed: The file link could not be made.
reports.noExports: No file of this report yet.

controls.title: Controls
controls.copy: Who may approve for whom, above which amounts a second person is needed, whether the books agree, and what is kept for how long. You see what your roles reach; each module still decides.
controls.noneReachable: None of your roles reaches a control.
controls.delegationsCopy: An approval you hold, lent to someone for a period of at most 90 days. The delegate still needs a role in the module, and never decides what they asked for themselves.
controls.delegateHint: The person's id, as in People and access.
controls.periodInvalid: The period must end on or after the day it starts.
controls.revokeFailed: The delegation could not be revoked.
controls.thresholdsCopy: Above these amounts a manual entry or a transfer waits for a second person. Without a threshold for a currency, nothing waits.
controls.amountHint: In the currency, with up to two decimals.
controls.thresholdInvalid: Type a currency code and an amount.
controls.consistencyCopy: Whether each module's balances agree with the Ledger, and every audit chain is intact. Reporting runs them daily.
controls.retentionCopy: What is kept, and for how long. Set by the deployment; this screen only shows it.

records.rule: Journal entries, titles, audit logs and the reporting journal are never removed.

events.rule: Kept: it is what a module replays from.

bookkeeping.rule: Received-message records after 90 days; command receipts after 30.

attachments.rule: Kept for as long as their record type requires.

agent.title: Agent access
agent.copy: Let your own AI agent read this workspace over MCP, with an API key and exactly what the person who issued it may read.
agent.endpointCopy: Point an MCP client here, with an API key as the Bearer token. The key needs agent:connect and a read scope for each module the agent reads.
agent.accessCopy: Off until an owner or admin turns it on. Turning it off refuses every agent at once.
agent.switchFailed: The switch could not be changed.
agent.accessAdminsOnly: Only a workspace owner or admin can see and change agent access.
agent.callsCopy: Every tool call, by key, from the agent audit log. Arguments and answers are never kept.
agent.callsAdminsOnly: Only a workspace owner, admin or auditor can read the call log.
agent.emptyCopy: Calls appear here as soon as an agent uses a key.

agentDrafts.badgeHint: Drafted by an agent through an API key; open the call log

assistant.title: Ask Horizon
assistant.copy: Answers from what you may read: records and attachments, each statement with its sources beside it. The assistant changes nothing.
assistant.kept: Each conversation is yours, kept 30 days after its last question, and gone if your account is erased.
assistant.empty: Ask about parties, orders, bills, opportunities, or what an attachment says.
assistant.question: Your question
assistant.placeholder: E.g. what does the coffee supply contract say?
assistant.noSources: The sources of the last answer appear here.
assistant.notFound: Not found in what you can read

stopped.stopped-budget: This month's budget ran out during this question.
stopped.stopped-off: The assistant was turned off during this question.

readiness.off: The assistant is off for this workspace. Nothing is sent.
readiness.unavailable: No model provider is configured ({provider}). Nothing is sent.
readiness.budget-spent: This month's assistant budget is spent.

refused.off: The assistant is off for this workspace.
refused.budget-spent: This month's assistant budget is spent.
refused.failed: The assistant could not answer now.

assistantSettings.title: Assistant
assistantSettings.copy: Turn the assistant on for the workspace, see what is sent, and cap the month's spending.
assistantSettings.noticeProvider: Questions are answered by {provider}, with the model {model}. Turning it on accepts that, as a subprocessor, it handles:

sends.question: the question of the person asking;
sends.conversation: the earlier questions and answers of the same conversation;
sends.tools: what the tools answered for that person: record data and attachment excerpts they may already read.

assistantSettings.noticeNever: Nothing is sent while the assistant is off, and nothing the person may not read. The assistant changes no record.
assistantSettings.unavailable: No provider key is configured: even when on, the assistant sends nothing.
assistantSettings.accept: I read the notice and accept the sending described above
assistantSettings.ownerOnly: Only a workspace owner turns the assistant on.
assistantSettings.spent: {spent} of {budget} tokens used ({percent}%) over {questions} question(s) this month.
assistantSettings.failed: The assistant settings could not be saved.

suggestions.fromExamples: {count, plural, one {As in # of your records} other {As in # of your records}}: {examples}
